## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 1:00 PM Eastern on Aug. 14, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot rounded to 6 percentage points this week. Both Democrats and Republicans saw some improvement in their numbers, with Democrats increasing from 49 last week to 49.4 this week, and Republicans increasing from 42.5 to 43.3.

results.content:
In the latest generic congressional voting poll by Economist/YouGov, 40% said if elections for Congress were being held today, they'd vote for the Democratic candidate compared to 32% that said Republican. A whopping 29% said other, not sure or that they would not vote at all.

In Polymarket betting odds on who will win the 2026 midterms, the odds are now favoring a Democratic Party win in both the Senate and the House.
